Eve K: Quick heads-up — seeing a latency regression on Qwen-70B (quant4a) on h100 in eu-west-1. Looks like throughput drops ~25% at seqlen=4096 vs our baseline. :eyes:
Jamal: Any kernel fallbacks in the logs? flash-attn vs generic?
Eve K: perf-bot posted the snapshot below. It fell back to generic_mm for the attention kernel around token 1024 for many requests. Full run: https://perf.redwood/ci/1851239999 (private)
perf-bot: SUMMARY: model=qwen-70b quant=4a region=eu-west-1 gpu=h100 seqlen=4096 batch=1 throughput=28 tok/s (baseline 37) p95=310ms (baseline 220ms) kernel_trace=[flash_attn_v2->generic_mm]
Priya: hmm — that fallback is suspicious. Could be rope/GQA codepath mismatch with our quantized kernels. Did you try forcing rope-optimized kernel?
Eve K: yes, I forced REDWOOD_RUNTIME_KERNEL=rope_opt and re-ran: throughput 34 tok/s p95=240ms (better, but still ~8% behind baseline on a100). Logs show GQA enabled in model metadata, but kernel selector prefers generic for some attention shapes.
Marta: can you paste the selector debug? small snippet is fine.
Eve K: selector output:
```
selector: input_seq=4096 model_arch=transformer_qwen rope_type=rotary_gqa kv_lengths=[1..4096]
kernel_score: flash_attn_v2=0.4 rope_opt=0.78 generic_mm=0.82
selected=generic_mm  # because quantized kernel unsupported for this gqa shape
```
Jamal: ah — score math picks generic_mm when quant kernel lacks GQA-support. We need a bisect: is perf regression from quantization (4a) vs kernel mapping? run with quant=fp16 and quant=4a with same kernel forced.
Priya: agreed. Also try mi250 in eu-central and h100 in us-east to see region/gpu delta. We had a weird context-sensitivity on mi250 for GQA earlier.
perf-bot: SCHEDULED: qe-bisect-job-1851240001 queued by Jamal. Commands to run locally:
```
# baseline fp16
bench-run --model qwen-70b --quant fp16 --kernel rope_opt --seq 4096 --batch 1 --gpu h100 --region eu-west-1
# quant4a forced rope kernel
bench-run --model qwen-70b --quant 4a --kernel rope_opt --seq 4096 --batch 1 --gpu h100 --region eu-west-1
# quant4a default selector
bench-run --model qwen-70b --quant 4a --kernel auto --seq 4096 --batch 1 --gpu h100 --region eu-west-1
```
Marta: also add seqlen=2048 to see if dropoff is thresholded. And include memprof output: --memprof kv_cache
Eve K: running 3 quick variants now, will post numbers.
Eve K: results (quick):
- fp16 + rope_opt: throughput=38 tok/s p95=218ms
- 4a + rope_opt: throughput=36 tok/s p95=235ms
- 4a + auto: throughput=28 tok/s p95=310ms (matches CI snapshot)
Jamal: that nails it — selector falling back to generic_mm causes big perf hit. Need quantized rope_opt kernel to support GQA shapes and large seq. Can we check kernel team's roadmap?
Priya: Nguyen from kernel team mentioned a quant4a/gqa patch in review last week (KERNEL-452). If it lands, selector should pick rope_opt for quant4a.
Marta: short-term mitigation: we can alter selector thresholds to prefer rope_opt when its score is within X% of generic_mm for quantized models — avoid fallback for high-seqlen. But must be conservative to not break correctness.
Eve K: agreed. Also want to double-check quality: quant4a + rope_opt vs fp16 for a set of eval prompts (long-context QA). I'll run eval-set-longqa and post regression numbers.
perf-bot: JOB DONE: qe-bisect-job-1851240001 finished. Attached artifacts: logs/1851240001.tar.gz, kernel_trace.json
Jamal: I'll open an issue KERNEL-489 to track quant4a+GQA kernel support + selector tuning and link the artifacts.
Priya: action items:
- Eve K: run long-context eval + memprof and attach diffs (ETA 3h)
- Jamal: open kernel ticket + attach logs (doing now)
- Marta: run mi250 replicate in eu-central and us-east (will start)
Eve K: thanks — marking this as high priority, will mute deployments hitting qwen-70b quant4a in eu-west for the hour to avoid user impact :thumbsup:
Jamal: thanks all :rocket:
